activate_scene.name: Activate scene
activate_scene.description: Activate a scene on the HDL Buspro bus: send a scene-control command to the given device address so the target device runs the specified area/scene.

address.name: Address
address.description: Target device address as [subnet id, device id], e.g. [1, 42].

scene_address.name: Scene address
scene_address.description: Area and scene number to activate as [area number, scene number], e.g. [1, 1].

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Send a raw HDL Buspro control message with a custom operate code and payload. Use for advanced or manual device control not covered by the dedicated services.

address.name: Address
address.description: Target device address as [subnet id, device id], e.g. [1, 42].

operate_code.name: Operate code
operate_code.description: HDL Buspro operate code as [high byte, low byte], e.g. [1, 1].

set_universal_switch.name: Set universal switch
set_universal_switch.description: Turn a universal switch output on or off: status 1 turns it on, status 0 turns it off.

address.name: Address
address.description: Target device address as [subnet id, device id], e.g. [1, 42].

status.name: Status
status.description: Desired state: 1 for on, 0 for off.
